Preconditions: Admin user is logged in; invoice create page is reachable; active product SP010 with stock is available.
Steps To Reproduce: 1. Log in as admin@osms.local. 2. Open /Admin/Invoices/Create. 3. Leave customer as walk-in. 4. Select SP010 with quantity 1. 5. Submit the invoice.
Expected Result: A new invoice should be created successfully, stock should be reduced, and the user should be redirected to the invoice details page.
Actual Result: Valid invoice creation stays on the Create page and shows the generic toast Failed to create invoice. Please check data and try again. Additional reruns confirmed the same root defect also blocks the insufficient-stock scenario and the tampered-price scenario before they can reach their intended business validation.
Notes: Confirmed defect because the base create flow, the insufficient-stock path, and the tampered-price path all fail on the same invoice-create transaction bug. A focused rerun on 2026-04-11 still reproduced the defect. GitHub Issue #1 remains the canonical issue-tool record.

Preconditions: Admin user is logged in; purchase create page is reachable; seeded supplier and product data are available.
Steps To Reproduce: 1. Open /Admin/Purchases/Create. 2. Submit with product lines but no supplier, or submit with supplier selected but no valid items. 3. Observe the validation banner on the create page.
Expected Result: The create form should stay on the page and show readable validation messages describing the missing supplier or missing item requirement.
Actual Result: The create form is blocked, but the red validation banner renders without readable validation text for both the missing-supplier and missing-item scenarios.
